titleEn: How to Verify Your Renovation Contractor is Licensed in BC
titleZh: 卑詩省裝修師傅資質核查：完整指南
contentEn:
Unlicensed renovation contractors remain the top source of consumer complaints to Consumer Protection BC every year. Before signing anything, verify yours in three minutes — it is free and takes three steps. Reno Stars holds active licensing under the Homeowner Protection Act; this is how any homeowner can check the same.

The Business Practices and Consumer Protection Act makes it illegal for a contractor to accept payment for renovation work without a valid consumer contractor licence. First offences carry fines up to $50,000; subsequent offences up to $100,000. Beyond the fine, an unlicensed contractor cannot pull building permits, cannot provide BC Housing-backed home warranty insurance, and cannot register a new home in the BC New Home Registration system.

How to Check if a Renovation Contractor is Licensed in BC

Three free checks take under five minutes combined. Start with the official registry, then verify insurance and WSBC coverage separately — each is a different authority.

  1. Go to the Consumer Protection BC business registry at consumerprotectionbc.ca and search the contractor's name or business number. Every licensed renovation contractor in BC must appear here. Note the licence class: Consumer Contractor is the correct class for residential renovation.
  2. Ask for their Certificate of Insurance showing Commercial General Liability of at least $1,000,000. Call the broker or insurer on the certificate to confirm the policy is active — a PDF can be forged, a phone call cannot.
  3. If the contractor has employees, ask for their WorkSafeBC account number and verify coverage at workSafeBC.com or by calling 1-888-967-5377. Subcontractors hired by the contractor are the contractor's responsibility to cover.

Why the BC Housing Warranty Matters

BC Housing administers the requirement for home warranty insurance on all residential renovation work valued over $3,000 including labour and materials. This warranty covers the homeowner for two years on labour and materials, five years on the building envelope, and ten years on structural defects. A contractor must be registered with BC Housing to issue this warranty. An unregistered contractor working on a home that is later sold may void the warranty entirely.

What to Verify Before Signing

Licence status alone is not enough. Check all three of the following before paying any deposit.

  • Consumer Protection BC registry — active licence, correct class, no current disciplinary orders.
  • Commercial General Liability — minimum $1,000,000 per occurrence, $2,000,000 aggregate. Ask for the broker's name and call to verify.
  • WorkSafeBC coverage — if the contractor employs anyone, WSBC coverage is legally mandatory. Without it, you may be liable for workplace injuries on your property.

Renovation Deposit Rules in BC

The Business Practices and Consumer Protection Act sets maximum deposit limits for consumer renovation contracts. The contractor may request a maximum of $10,000 or 10% of the contract price, whichever is less. Any payment above this cap is immediately refundable if the contractor fails to begin work on the agreed start date. These rules exist because deposits above the cap have been used to cover other contractors' debts in bankruptcy proceedings.

Questions to Ask Before Hiring Any Renovation Contractor

Before agreeing to any contract, ask the following and verify every answer independently:

  • Can you provide your Consumer Protection BC licence number and show the registry listing?
  • What is your WSBC account number, and can I verify coverage directly with WorkSafeBC?
  • Can I speak directly with three past clients from the past 24 months?
  • Do you carry Commercial General Liability, and may I call your broker to confirm the policy is active?
  • Are you registered with BC Housing for home warranty insurance?
  • Will you pull the building permit in my name, and will the permit number appear on my property records?

Frequently Asked Questions

How do I verify a contractor's licence in BC for free?

Search the contractor's name or business number on the Consumer Protection BC website registry at consumerprotectionbc.ca. Every active consumer contractor licence in BC appears there. Note the licence number, issue date, and any active conditions. If the contractor cannot be found on the registry, do not hire them — this is the official source under the Business Practices and Consumer Protection Act.

What is the maximum renovation deposit allowed in BC?

Under the Business Practices and Consumer Protection Act, the maximum deposit for a consumer renovation contract is $10,000 or 10% of the contract price, whichever is lower. Any amount above this cap is not enforceable and must be refunded if the contractor fails to start work on the agreed date. Reno Stars adheres to this limit on every project.

Can I verify a contractor's WorkSafeBC coverage myself?

Yes. Ask the contractor for their WorkSafeBC account number and verify coverage directly at workSafeBC.com or by calling 1-888-967-5377. WSBC coverage is mandatory for any worker employed by a contractor in BC. Without it, you as the property owner may be responsible for workplace injury claims.

Why is written contract required for renovation work in BC?

Under the Law and Equity Act, a consumer renovation contract over $150 must be in writing to be enforceable in BC Small Claims or Supreme Court. Written contracts protect homeowners when disputes arise over scope, payment, or timelines. Courts have awarded homeowners between 50% and 85% of disputed amounts in cases where the contractor failed to deliver the agreed work.

在卑詩省，無牌裝修師傅一直是消費者保護局接獲最多投訴的原因之一。在簽署任何合約之前，只需三分鐘即可核查師傅資質，整個過程免費而且簡單。聚星裝修持有《房屋保護法》規定的有效牌照，以下是任何業主都可以使用的核查方法。

《商業行為和消費者保護法》明確規定，承建商不得在未持有有效消費者承建商牌照的情況下收取裝修工程款項。初犯罰款可達五萬加元；再犯可達十萬加元。更重要的是，無牌承建商無法代為申請建築許可、無法提供卑詩房屋局擔保的房屋保險，也無法在卑詩新住宅登記系統中為住宅進行登記。

如何核查卑詩省裝修承建商是否持牌

三項免費核查，合計不超過五分鐘。先查官方登記冊，再分別核查保險和 WorkSafeBC 保障——三個機構各有不同職責。

  1. 前往 Consumer Protection BC 商業登記冊（consumerprotectionbc.ca），輸入承建商名稱或商業登記號碼。所有持牌的卑詩省住宅裝修承建商均須列於此。確認牌照類別為 Consumer Contractor，即住宅裝修的正確類別。
  2. 要求查看其商業一般責任險保單證明書，保額至少為一百萬加元。致電保險經紀或保險公司確認保單是否有效——PDF 可以偽造，電話無法偽造。
  3. 若承建商有員工，請提供其 WorkSafeBC 帳戶號碼，並透過 workSafeBC.com 或致電 1-888-967-5377 確認保障範圍。分包商由總承建商負責投保。

廚房、浴室、全屋或商業裝修？立即聯絡聚星裝修，免費估價。

為何卑詩房屋局保修這麼重要

卑詩房屋局監管一項規定：工程造價（含人工和材料）超過三千加元的住宅裝修工程，必須購買房屋保修保險。該保修涵蓋業主為期兩年的人工和材料保障、五年外牆保障，以及十年結構缺陷保障。承建商必須在卑詩房屋局登記，才能出具此保修。日後出售住宅時，未經登記的承建商所進行的工程可能令保修失效。

簽約前必須核查的三件事

僅核查牌照狀態並不足夠。支付任何訂金前，必須完成以下三項核查。

  • Consumer Protection BC 登記冊——有效牌照、正確類別、無紀律處分記錄。
  • 商業一般責任險——每次事故最低一百萬加元、合計二百萬加元。索取經紀名稱並致電核實。
  • WorkSafeBC 保障——若承建商有員工，WorkSafeBC 保障在法律上屬強制性。若無保障，財產所有者可能需對工傷索償負責。

卑詩省裝修訂金規定

《商業行為和消費者保護法》就消費者裝修合約訂定了最高訂金限額。承建商最高可收取一萬加元或合約價格的百分之十，以較低者為準。超過此上限的任何款項，若承建商未能在約定日期開工，須立即退還。設定此上限的原因在於，超過上限的訂金曾被用於償還其他債權人的債務，最終導致破產。

僱用裝修承建商前必問的六個問題

同意任何合約前，先提出以下問題，並獨立核實每個答案：

  • 能否提供您的 Consumer Protection BC 牌照號碼，並在登記冊上顯示記錄？
  • 您的 WorkSafeBC 帳戶號碼是什麼？我可以直接向 WorkSafeBC 核實嗎？
  • 能否提供三個過去二十四個月內合作客戶的直接聯絡方式？
  • 您是否持有商業一般責任險？我可以致電您的保險經紀確認保單有效嗎？
  • 您是否已在卑詩房屋局登記房屋保修險？
  • 您是否會以我的名字申請建築許可，且許可編號會出現在我的房產記錄上？

廚房、浴室、全屋或商業裝修？立即聯絡聚星裝修，免費估價。

常見問題

如何免費核查承建商的卑詩省牌照？

在 Consumer Protection BC 官方網站的登記冊（consumerprotectionbc.ca）輸入承建商名稱或商業登記號碼。所有有效消費者承建商牌照均列於此。記下牌照號碼、簽發日期及任何有效條件。若在登記冊上找不到該承建商，切勿聘用——這是《商業行為和消費者保護法》規定的官方來源。

卑詩省裝修訂金上限是多少？

根據《商業行為和消費者保護法》，消費者裝修合約的最高訂金為一萬加元或合約價格的百分之十，以較低者為準。超過此上限的款項，若承建商未能在約定開工日期開工，則不得執行且必須退還。聚星裝修在每個項目中均遵守此限額。

我可以自行核查承建商的 WorkSafeBC 保障嗎？

可以。要求承建商提供 WorkSafeBC 帳戶號碼，並透過 workSafeBC.com 或致電 1-888-967-5377 直接核實。WorkSafeBC 保障是卑詩省所有承建商員工的法律強制要求。若承建商未投保，您作為業主可能需對工地工傷索償承擔責任。

為何卑詩省裝修工程需要書面合約？

根據《法律與衡平法》，造價超過一百五十加元的消費者裝修合約，必須以書面形式訂立，方能在卑詩省小額錢債法庭或最高法院執行。書面合約在工程範圍、付款或工期發生爭議時，可保障業主權利。法庭曾在承建商未能完成約定工程案件中，判給業主爭議金額的百分之五十至八十五。
